title: 第四章 好像被撩到了
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那边不行……”

姜枝的声音拐得那叫一个九曲十八弯。不敢抬头看人，天晓得面对我推的爱豆的那张脸，她竟然能发出这么不要脸的声效。

太尴尬了。

但为了活命，姜枝只能继续演，甚至还抬手拍了两下石壁，制造一点动静。

“轻、轻一点……”

最后那句她几乎是闭着眼喊出来的。

直到外面彻底没了动静，姜枝才像被抽干了力气一样，僵硬地站在原地，整张脸一点一点涨红。

过了好半天，洞外才传来一阵明显慌乱的脚步声，还有人压低了声音结结巴巴地说：

“走、走吧走吧……”

“快去回祭司，就说她……她暂时脱不开身。”

脚步声迅速远去，像生怕再晚一点就会听见什么不该听的。

她缓缓转回身，正对上苍凛的视线。

苍凛脸上也依旧没什么表情，可那份冷硬里，却分明多了点别的东西。

那对本来一直压着的狼耳，此刻竟有些不受控制地轻轻颤动，耳根泛起一层很薄的热意，呼吸声也变得沉重。

姜枝：“……”

她下意识往下瞟了一眼。

怎么有反应啊？！

说好的恨之入骨，恨不得杀了她呢？

大概是察觉到了她那一瞬间僵住的目光，苍凛的下颌线骤然绷紧，原本就冷的神色一下子更沉了几分，甚至带着几分狼狈。

他猛地扯过兽皮，动作比刚才更快，像是恼极了。

又像是……真的被刚才那几声乱七八糟的给撩到了。

空气一下子变得格外古怪。

姜枝站在原地，脚趾已经开始在地上疯狂抠三室一厅。

死嘴，快点说些什么啊！

半晌，姜枝终于调整好情绪，不敢看苍凛，避重就轻道

“我没别的意思。不去看首领，是因为……我昨天刚和他吵过架。”

“我现在过去干什么？两个人大眼瞪小眼，气氛多尴尬啊。”

“万一我一开口，伤口还没处理好，先把他气出个好歹来怎么办？”

姜枝表面稳如老狗，心里却已经开始疯狂抽自己嘴巴子。

"It doesn't work over there..."

Jiang Zhi's voice made a twist and turn.I didn't dare to raise my head to look at anyone. God knows that when facing the face of the idol I pushed, she could actually make such a shameless sound.

So embarrassing.

But in order to survive, Jiang Zhi could only continue to act, and even raised his hand to pat the stone wall twice to create some movement.

"L-light..."

She almost shouted the last sentence with her eyes closed.

It wasn't until there was absolutely no movement outside that Jiang Zhi stood stiffly on the spot, as if his strength had been drained away, his whole face turning red little by little.

After a long time, there was a sound of obviously panicked footsteps outside the cave, and someone stammered in a lowered voice:

"Go, let's go, let's go..."

"Go back to the priest quickly, tell her...she can't get away for the time being."

The sound of footsteps quickly faded away, as if he was afraid that he would hear something he shouldn't hear if it was too late.

She slowly turned around and faced Cang Lin's gaze.

Cang Lin's face was still expressionless, but there was clearly something else in that coldness.

The pair of wolf ears that had been pressed down now were trembling slightly uncontrollably, a thin layer of warmth appeared at the base of the ears, and the sound of breathing became heavy.

Jiang Zhi: "..."

She glanced down subconsciously.

Why are you reacting?!

He said he hated her so much that he wanted to kill her?

Probably sensing her frozen gaze at that moment, Cang Lin's jawline suddenly tightened, and his already cold expression suddenly became a little darker, even a little embarrassed.

He yanked at the hide, moving faster than before, as if he was extremely annoyed.

It's like... I was really aroused by those random noises just now.

The air suddenly became very strange.

Jiang Zhi stood there, his toes already starting to dig at the ground like crazy.

Damn you, say something quickly!

After a long while, Jiang Zhi finally adjusted his mood and did not dare to look at Cang Lin. He avoided the important matter and said lightly.

"I don't mean anything else. I don't want to see the leader because... I just had a quarrel with him yesterday."

"What am I going to do now? The two people are staring at each other, and the atmosphere is so awkward."

"What if I open my mouth and the wound is not treated yet, and I make him angry first?"

On the surface, Jiang Zhi was as calm as an old dog, but in his heart, he was already slapping himself wildly.
